verdict.rationale: HMRC is a government tax authority whose online services and Making Tax Digital APIs handle registration and filing. It does not host user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The probe shows a versioned REST API, but that is the API's own versioning, not a capability for managing user automations, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
